name: FLORES-200: Multilingual Machine Translation Benchmark
description: FLORES-200 is an evaluation benchmark for machine translation covering 204 languages and language varieties. It consists of 3,001 sentences professionally translated from 842 diverse web articles across books, travel guides, news, and Wikipedia into 204 languages, yielding over 40,000 translation evaluation directions.
